Hi Alex / Sara — great to meet you both on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (30 min discovery)
- Use-case: Medisys wants a sub-100ms 1kB embedding/semantic search path for clinical search with predictable cost.
- Constraints: SOC2 attestation required, data residency (EU) for a subset of patient data, dedicated capacity during monthly reporting windows.
- Success criteria: POC latency <120ms 95th, monthly running cost estimate within budget cap (TBD).

Next meeting: technical deep dive + demo (45–60 min) — goal is to validate API integration pattern and sizing. During the call we brought up the difficulty aligning US/EU/APAC calendars — to avoid losing time with repeated reschedules I sketched a rotating schedule that shares burden fairly across timezones.

Proposed: week-rotation demo slots (we'll own scheduling & calendar invites)
- Week A (Americas-friendly): 9:00–10:00 PT / 13:00–14:00 ET / 18:00–19:00 GMT
- Week B (EMEA-friendly): 08:00–09:00 PT / 13:00–14:00 GMT / 22:00–23:00 SGT
- Week C (APAC-friendly): 17:00–18:00 PT / 01:00–02:00 GMT / 09:00–10:00 SGT

I attached a short mutual action plan and an .ics with the three rotating slots (Mutual_Action_Plan_Medisys.xlsx, proposed-rotating-slots.ics). Can you confirm which of the three slot types you'd prefer to start with for week 1, and who from your side should be on the tech deep dive (API engineer, infra lead, compliance)?

If that works I'll:
- Draft a 45m agenda and share the invite for the Week A slot this coming Tue/Wed (adjust if you prefer to start with B or C)
- Add Ben (RE: capacity sizing) and Grace (security/compliance) to the meeting

Thanks — talk soon.

—
